|translation='''Title:''' Overload.

'''Card text:''' Choose any one weapon except a [[Gaderffii Stick]] or an Ewok weapon as the target. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than that weapon's destiny, the weapon is lost. If destiny is 0, the character or starship carrying the weapon is also lost at the same time.<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Overload-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

'''Lore:''' Weapons such as lightsabers, turbolasers and blasters operate using powerful energy cells or generators. Sometimes a cell overheats and explodes together with the weapon.<ref name="jp-face" />
